newsitem.title: CROATIA: Ivana Trump may promote Croatian tourism.
newsitem.headline: Ivana Trump may promote Croatian tourism.

text.p: Ivana Trump, former wife of American tycoon Donald Trump, met Croatian government officials on Monday to discuss promoting Croatian tourism, the state agency HINA reported.

Ivana Trump and current husband Richard Mazzuchielli were received by presidential chief of staff Hrvoje Sarinic. They expressed interest in helping revive the country's tourism following the war in former Yugoslavia, the agency said.
Sarinic said Croatia's tourism industry would soon have recovered to pre-war levels and added that developing tourism with all necessary infrastructure was among national goals.
